# UK.COM
> UK.COM is an open, globally recognized domain for the United Kingdom with unrestricted registration and premium name availability.

UK.COM promotes a UK-focused web identity for businesses, startups, and individuals seeking UK market visibility without local registration restrictions. The site provides registration entry points, policy pages, sitemap access, contact options, and external WHOIS and abuse reporting resources.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://uk.com/): Overview of the UK.COM domain, benefits, comparison points, and registration calls to action.
- [Register](https://uk.com/#search): Domain search and registration entry point for securing a UK.COM name.
- [Why .UK.COM?](https://uk.com/#why): Explains the value proposition, market visibility, SEO accessibility, and global reach.
- [Live Sites](https://uk.com/#live): Highlights active websites using UK.COM domains as real-world examples.
- [Contact Us](https://uk.com/#contact): Contact section for inquiries related to UK.COM domains and registry information.

## Domain Benefits
- [Unrestricted Global Access](https://uk.com/#why): Describes open registration with no local presence or residency restrictions.
- [UK Market Visibility with Global Reach](https://uk.com/#why): Explains how UK.COM supports UK branding while remaining internationally accessible.
- [SEO & Market Accessibility](https://uk.com/#why): Positions UK.COM as a practical option for discoverability and market entry.
- [Premium Availability](https://uk.com/#why): Emphasizes stronger availability of desirable names compared with crowded alternatives.
- [Seamless Expansion for Businesses & Startups](https://uk.com/#why): Presents UK.COM as a flexible namespace for growth-oriented organizations.

## Registration & Discovery
- [Register Your .UK.COM Domain](https://uk.com/#search): Primary call to action for searching and registering a UK.COM domain.
- [Unlock the Power of the UK’s Digital Market](https://uk.com/#search): Registration-focused section encouraging entry into the UK online market.
- [The Global Domain for the United Kingdom](https://uk.com/): Core positioning page for UK.COM as a UK-oriented global domain.
- [.UK.COM vs. Other UK Domain Options](https://uk.com/#why): Comparison-oriented content contrasting UK.COM with other UK namespace choices.

## Policies & Legal
- [Privacy Policy](https://uk.com/privacy-policy): Describes how personal data is collected, used, and protected on the site.
- [Terms of Use](https://uk.com/terms-of-use): Sets the rules and conditions governing use of the UK.COM website.
- [Registry Policies](https://uk.com/registry-policies): Provides registry-level policies relevant to UK.COM domain operations and registrations.

## Support & Contact
- [Contact Us](https://uk.com/#contact): Contact form or inquiry section for support, partnership, or general questions.
- [Report Abuse](https://gen.xyz/abuse): External abuse reporting page for domain misuse, spam, phishing, or other violations.
- [WHOIS](https://whois.centralnicregistry.com/): External WHOIS lookup for checking registration data and domain status.

## Site Structure
- [Sitemap](https://uk.com/sitemap): Index of site pages for navigation and discovery.
- [Home](https://uk.com/): Main landing page linking to registration, benefits, live sites, and policy resources.
- [Live Sites](https://uk.com/#live): Navigational anchor for browsing examples of websites using UK.COM domains.
